purpose: Freeze what was recovered from historical JANUS code and what is already preregistered before the independent factorized-resolution holdout result is known.

historical_recovery.article_policy: The two March 2026 articles are treated as search leads. Only exact repository/release code is promoted to verified historical mechanism.
recovered_mechanisms: hybrid SAT witness proposer: clause weighting + WalkSAT + hill climb + population evolution + assignment memory
independent raw 3-SAT assignment checker as a separable component
historical_debts: The historical verifier was scoring/heuristic rather than an exact proof kernel.
Historical compression was serialization compression and did not prove semantic preservation.
Historical SAT orchestration trusted the agent solved flag rather than independently replaying every returned assignment through NPTask.check_solution.
A timeout-tail comparison mixed weighted fitness with the raw number of clauses.
Random phase-transition 3-SAT timing curves are engineering evidence, not worst-case complexity evidence.

older_fundamentum_debts_recovered_by_spi.POLICY0A_CONTEXT_INTERSECTION: A shared state reached under incompatible decision boundaries may require context-sensitive semantics.
older_fundamentum_debts_recovered_by_spi.POLICY0A_DIAMOND_BYPASS: Speedup over a particular execution policy is not a proof-system separation or universal complexity gain.
